description: Source code for the class HTMLPurifier_VarParser, which parses string representations into native PHP variable types and performs validation.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_VarParser
classes.description: A class that parses string representations into their corresponding native PHP variable types and validates them.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Validates and type-coerces a variable according to specified type, throwing exceptions if invalid.

methods.name: parseImplementation
methods.description: Base implementation of parsing, meant to be overridden by subclasses.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Throws an HTMLPurifier_VarParserException with a message.

methods.name: errorInconsistent
methods.description: Throws an HTMLPurifier_Exception indicating an inconsistency in type handling.

methods.name: errorGeneric
methods.description: Throws a generic error when a variable does not match expected type.

methods.name: getTypeName
methods.description: Returns the string name of a type constant.
